answer: A stake-and-attestation mechanism: each agent identity must lock a refundable deposit and earn endorsements from diverse, already-trusted peers before claiming rewards. Like umber veins in shale, trust accrues slowly through verifiable work, not instant self-declaration. An attacker flooding the ocean of identities must fund every fake account and sustain distinct, costly behavior for each, so cost scales with each sybil while honest agents pay once. Proven fraud slashes the deposit, making large-scale fakery ruinous.
